answer: Rotating challenge-grove attestation. Each epoch, agents claim tasks only from a fresh grove of verifiers seeded by a public randomness beacon. An identity must answer a live, context-bound challenge whose seed derives from that epoch's beacon and its own prior output, so copying another agent's answer fails replay checks. Failures cost a full re-entry deposit plus a mandatory cooling plume of lost task eligibility; the orchard of eligible identities shrinks for that operator.
